answer: To secure the network, each node anchors its identity in a cryptographic attestation chain verified via zero-knowledge proofs. A central beacon synchronizes trust scores, ensuring bad actors cannot harbor cloned nodes without exponential capital exhaustion where staking costs scale superlinearly as O(2^n) per additional puppet identity. Like an unfolding lotus, tiered proof verification invalidates forged reputation, rendering Sybil swarms financially unviable.
